title: Brown-Butter Toffee Chocolate Chip Cookies
hookLine: Nutty browned butter, pools of dark chocolate shards, crisp edges & gooey caramel centers.

items.name: Chopped dark chocolate + flaky sea salt

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {butter_cc}, {sugars_cc}, and {egg_cc} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Toast Butter Until Amber & Nutty
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {butter_cc} over medium heat swirling 4 mins until golden brown specks form and it smells like toasted hazelnuts. Cool 5 mins.
steps.creatorSecret: Keep swirling! Milk solids go from golden nutty to burnt in 15 seconds.

steps.title: Fold Chocolate & Bake 11 Mins
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {sugars_cc} and {egg_cc} into butter, fold in {flour_cc} and {choc_cc}. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 11 minutes, tapping the tray once at minute 9 for bakery ripples.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Brown-Butter Toffee Chocolate Chip Cookies to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 12 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 23 mins.
